title: Technical Debt Break-Even Explorer
creator: Katie Jo Schuman
subject: AI economics
description: The learner will assess, for each of eight scenarios, whether an AI saving can be reported as stated, must be restated net of debt, or is net negative, using thresholds on the share of the gross saving that the debt consumes.

learningObjectives: The learner will assess, for each of eight scenarios, whether an AI saving can be reported as stated, must be restated net of debt, or is net negative, using thresholds on the share of the gross saving that the debt consumes.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit-then-explore: predict, receive feedback, then explore
commonMisconceptions: (1) A positive gross saving means a positive result. (2) A small debt rate is always negligible. (3) Hours per refactoring do not matter if the rate is low.
assessmentOpportunities: For each of eight scenarios the learner commits one of three verdicts before the arithmetic is shown. A verdict is correct when it matches the Content table. Mastery is 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt. Exploration is not evidence.
